articles.title: Experts release early Oregon vs. Washington predictions, best bets for Saturday’s rivalry game
articles.summary: The Oregon Ducks and Washington Huskies face off Saturday with early expert picks and wagering recommendations already circulating ahead of the rivalry matchup. This game matters because sharp bettors move prediction markets fast, and early expert consensus often signals where the smart money's already flowing.

articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also likely illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, the prediction markets platform, is getting slapped with legal pushback over sports betting offerings that regulators say violate federal law. If the feds actually enforce this, it could crater the entire regulatory gray zone that lets prediction markets operate in the US.

articles.title: Will Aaron Rodgers Retire? Next Team Odds on Kalshi & Polymarket (Nov 2026)
articles.summary: Aaron Rodgers is facing a career crossroads with retirement odds now live on Kalshi and Polymarket, alongside betting lines on which team lands him if he keeps playing. The uncertainty cuts both ways for traders: retirement bets offer clean binary resolution, while team odds stay juicy as long as he remains unsigned.

articles.title: Best Prediction Market Apps & Promos for Eagles vs Cowboys
articles.summary: The piece breaks down the prediction market apps and promotional offers available for the upcoming Eagles-Cowboys matchup. For bettors, it's the difference between getting +110 odds or +140 odds, which on a $100 bet swings your expected return by 27%.

articles.title: Analysis: Kalshi Largely Accurate On Trump Mention Markets
articles.summary: Kalshi's Trump mention markets actually predicted what people would say during public events, turning out to be surprisingly reliable at forecasting real-world language patterns. That's a big deal because it proves micro-event markets work for things everyone assumes are too random to predict, which opens the door to monetizing literally any discrete outcome you can describe.

articles.title: 'Dancing with the Stars' Prediction Market: Ezra Frech Wins S35
articles.summary: Ezra Frech, a Paralympic athlete with no prior dance experience, won season 35 of Dancing with the Stars, defying the typical pattern where professional dancers or entertainment celebrities dominate the competition. The upset win signals that prediction markets may have been systematically undervaluing outsider contestants and overweighting celebrity status and dance background as predictive factors.

articles.title: Most Polymarket users lost money betting on the U.S. midterms, report finds
articles.summary: A new report shows that the majority of Polymarket users took losses on their midterm election bets, suggesting retail prediction market participants are worse at forecasting than the crowd consensus. If true, this reveals a painful gap between how good casual bettors think they are and how good they actually are, which could reshape who participates in prediction markets going forward.

articles.title: Where Every League Stands on Kalshi, Polymarket
articles.summary: Sports leagues are finally taking positions on whether prediction market platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket should exist, and their stances are all over the map. The answer determines whether US bettors get legal access to these platforms or watch them get crushed by the same establishment that's already regulated traditional sportsbooks.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: Gold drops below $3,500; prediction markets price moderate year-end targets (XAUUSD:CUR:Commodity)
articles.summary: Gold just fell below $3,500 and the prediction market crowd is basically yawning at year-end, pricing in a pretty modest bounce from here. That matters because it suggests either gold bugs are finally losing faith or the smart money sees better returns parked elsewhere before December.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Van Hollen's framing of the Democratic leadership race as unsettled contradicts what the smart money is already pricing in with Schumer as the favorite. The discrepancy between insider rhetoric and market consensus is exactly the kind of signal that gets exploited when backroom dynamics shift faster than odds move.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers are partnering with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, marking a major sports team's official embrace of event contracts. This legitimizes prediction markets as a mainstream sports engagement tool and signals that regulated prediction betting is becoming the norm rather than the exception in professional sports.
